text_en: The Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners, which the Assembly of the Republic of Macedonia adopted at its session held on 9 December 2015, is hereby promulgated.
summary: The President and the Speaker promulgate the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners, adopted by the Assembly on 9 December 2015.

text_en: (1) This law regulates the conditions and procedure under which foreigners may be employed or work in the Republic of Macedonia, unless a ratified international treaty provides otherwise.
summary: The law regulates the conditions and procedure for foreigners to be employed or work, unless a ratified treaty provides otherwise.

text_en: The draft resolution to the Government is prepared by the Ministry of Internal Affairs in cooperation with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy.
summary: The Interior Ministry prepares the draft resolution on foreigner employment policy with the foreign affairs and labour ministries.

text_en: (1) The quota of work permits for foreigners who may be employed in the territory of the Republic of Macedonia (hereinafter: the quota) is proposed to the Government by the minister responsible for labour, on a proposal of the Employment Agency of the Republic of Macedonia (hereinafter: the Employment Agency), in cooperation with the ministers responsible for the relevant areas, in accordance with the legal provision
summary: The labour minister proposes the work permit quota to the Government on the Employment Agency's proposal; the Economic and Social Council may give an opinion.

text_en: (10) Individual increases above the annual quota during the year will be approved in exceptional cases, if the Government determines that this is in the public commercial interest of the state. In such cases the Government will determine the scope and duration of this type of quota increase, on a proposal of the competent chamber, in agreement with the representative trade unions at national level, the ministry respo
summary: The Government may exceptionally raise the annual quota in the public commercial interest, on a chamber's proposal and with unions and responsible ministries.

text_en: (4) The foreigner's work permit will be withdrawn and annulled if: 1) the foreigner's temporary or permanent residence permit has ended in accordance with law; 2) the foreigner stays outside the Republic of Macedonia for more than six months without interruption, except where the foreigner is posted abroad by order of the employer or is absent because of education, illness, maternity leave or childcare leave and 3) t
summary: A work permit is withdrawn if residence ends, the foreigner stays abroad over six months without interruption, or does other work than permitted.

text_en: (5) The provisions of paragraph (4) point 2 of this article do not apply to foreigners who hold a work permit valid for an indefinite period.
summary: The six-month absence ground does not apply to holders of a work permit valid for an indefinite period.

text_en: (6) The minister responsible for labour prescribes the manner of issuing work permits and the form and content of work permits, as well as the form and content of the permit form.
summary: The labour minister prescribes how work permits are issued and their form and content.

text_en: (2) Against the decision of the Employment Agency, as the first-instance body, rejecting the foreigner's application for a work permit, the foreigner has the right to appeal within eight days of receiving the decision to the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy.
summary: A foreigner refused a work permit may appeal to the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy within eight days.

text_en: (5) Against the Employment Agency's decision referred to in paragraph (3) of this article, the foreigner has the right to appeal within eight days of receiving the decision to the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy.
summary: A foreigner whose work permit is withdrawn may appeal to the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy within eight days.

text_en: (6) The ministry decides on appeals under paragraphs (2) and (5) of this article within 15 days of the appeal being filed.
summary: The ministry decides on work permit appeals within 15 days.

text_en: (4) The form and content of the application form and the required documents are prescribed by the minister responsible for labour.
summary: The labour minister prescribes the application form and the required documents.

text_en: (1) Foreigners who themselves provide creative services in the field of culture as participants in cultural workshops, meetings, colonies and other cultural events or as reporters on such events, as creators and adapters in music, musical performances, dance, ballet and literary works, photography, video, film and electronic media art, as accompanying staff for instructors, reporting and organisational and technical
summary: Foreign creative cultural service providers staying up to seven days need prior consent from a culture or economy ministry, youth and sport agency or municipality.

text_en: (1) A work permit is not required in the following cases: 1) services by foreign workers connected with the supply of goods and the assembly of machines, assets and equipment, where the provider gives introductory instructions to the client's staff and where the services accompany the dismantling of the machines, assets and equipment; 2) where regular maintenance services are needed, if agreed in the purchase contrac
summary: No work permit is needed for equipment supply and assembly, contracted maintenance, supplier defect repair, or registered work of up to 60 days.

text_en: (2) In the cases in paragraph (1) of this article, the client for whom the services are intended must register the service, the work performed by the foreigners, within three days of the foreigners' arrival in the country at the Employment Agency in the place where the client has its seat.
summary: For emergency services, the client must register the foreigners' work with the Employment Agency within three days of their arrival.

text_en: (1) Registration of the work performed by foreigners is a mandatory condition that applies to all foreigners who, under the provisions of this or another law, are employed or work in the Republic of Macedonia.
summary: Registering work performed by foreigners is mandatory for all foreigners employed or working in the country.

text_en: (3) The responsible persons referred to in paragraph (2) of this article must report: 1. within one day of the start of work, where an employment relationship is established; 2. one day before work begins, where no employment relationship with the foreigner is established; 3. within three days of the foreigner's arrival in the country, in the cases in Article 15 paragraph (2) of this law.
summary: Responsible persons must report a foreigner's work within one day of starting, one day before starting, or within three days of arrival.

text_en: (8) The manner of registering and ending the work performed by foreigners, the evidence attached to the application, and the exchange of data from separate registrations between separate bodies and services are prescribed by the minister responsible for labour.
summary: The labour minister prescribes registration and ending of foreigners' work, supporting evidence, and data exchange between bodies.

text_en: The Employment Agency processes the collected data on registration and deregistration of foreigners' work monthly, compares them with the data on work permits issued within the separate purposes by which the work permit quota is divided, and reports the results to the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy and the State Labour Inspectorate and, on request, to the other bodies and services responsible for implementing t
summary: The Employment Agency monthly compares foreigners' work registrations with permits issued and reports to the labour ministry and the State Labour Inspectorate.

text_en: (1) Supervision of the implementation of this law is performed by the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy.
summary: The Ministry of Labour and Social Policy supervises implementation of the law.

text_en: (3) The Employment Agency may collect, exchange and record data on foreigners from the records kept at the Ministry of Internal Affairs on residence in the Republic of Macedonia, the Health Insurance Fund of the Republic of Macedonia on health insurance, and the Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of Macedonia on the pension and disability insurance of foreigners in the Republic of Macedonia.
summary: The Employment Agency may collect, exchange and record foreigners' data from interior ministry, health insurance fund and pension fund records.

text_en: (6) The Agency obtains evidence and data ex officio from other bodies, and delivers data at the request of other bodies, by electronic means.
summary: The Agency obtains evidence and data from other bodies, and supplies data to them, electronically.
note: Theme test not met: national data exchange by one agency, no EU system or public service (R22). Stays in scope under LIM-0019 as part of the law.

text_en: (7) Communication between the Agency and other public bodies and institutions must take place in electronic form.
summary: Communication between the Agency and other public bodies must be electronic.
note: Theme test not met: national data exchange by one agency, no EU system or public service (R22). Stays in scope under LIM-0019 as part of the law.

text_en: (2) A fine of 25 to 50 euros in denar equivalent is imposed for an offence on an official of the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy who does not decide on a filed appeal within 15 days, contrary to Article 8 paragraph (7) of this law.
summary: An official of the labour ministry who does not decide an appeal within 15 days is fined 25 to 50 euros.

text_en: (9) The minister responsible for labour prescribes the form and content of the misdemeanour payment order.
summary: The labour minister prescribes the form and content of the misdemeanour payment order.

text_en: (2) The quota shall not cover foreigners: 1) who, on the basis of a reciprocity agreement with the European Union, have been given equality with the nationals of the Republic of Macedonia,
summary: The quota excludes foreigners given equality with nationals under a reciprocity agreement with the European Union.
note: Bears on the confirmed contradiction between MKD-EU-2024-001-0058 and MKD-EU-2025-003-0010 (G5-D03).

text_en: The Law on Amending and Supplementing the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners, which the Assembly of the Republic of North Macedonia adopted at its session held on 15 July 2021, is hereby promulgated.
summary: The President and the Speaker promulgate the amending law on employment and work of foreigners, adopted by the Assembly on 15 July 2021.

text_en: In the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners (Official Gazette of the Republic of Macedonia No. 217/15), in Article 7 paragraph (4), point 2) is deleted. Point 3) becomes point 2).
summary: The amending law deletes point 2 of Article 7(4) of the 2015 Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners and renumbers point 3.

text_en: In paragraph (5), the words "holds a work permit valid for an indefinite period" are replaced by the words "during the period of validity of the residence permit are employed with the same employer in another job at the same or a higher position than the previous one".
summary: Article 7(5) is reworded: the reference to an indefinite work permit becomes employment with the same employer at the same or higher position.

text_en: "(6) An application for the issuing of a work permit is submitted on the appropriate form to the Employment Agency of the Republic of North Macedonia (hereinafter: the Employment Agency) or to its competent regional offices.
summary: Work permit applications are submitted on the prescribed form to the Employment Agency or its competent regional offices.

text_en: (7) If the employer for any reason fails to establish the employment relationship within the deadline in Article 16 paragraph (6) point 1 of this law, or terminates the employment of the foreigner before the work permit expires, it must return the work permit to the issuing body within 30 days of the cessation of activity or of the failure to establish the employment relationship. Self-employed persons who stopped th
summary: Employers who do not start or end a foreigner's employment early, and self-employed persons who stop work, must return the work permit within 30 days.

text_en: In paragraph (6), which becomes paragraph (8), the words "of the permit" are replaced by the words "of the application for the issuing of a work permit".
summary: In renumbered Article 7(8) the reference to the permit is replaced by a reference to the work permit application.

text_en: In Article 9, paragraph (4) is deleted.
summary: The amending law deletes paragraph 4 of Article 9 of the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners.

text_en: In Article 13 paragraph (1), in point 3), the conjunction "and" is replaced by a semicolon. Point 4) is amended to read: "where, on the basis of an appropriate act for servicing and maintenance of machines, assets or equipment, the service provider is obliged at its own cost to identify and repair the defects of the machines, assets or equipment that are the subject of the contract;".
summary: Article 13(1) point 4 is replaced: servicing and repair of machines or equipment at the service provider's own cost becomes a listed case.

text_en: After point 4), two new points 5) and 6) are added, which read: "5) where, on the basis of an appropriate act on on-the-job training, the foreign legal entity is obliged to train a certain number of workers at the legal entity in the Republic of North Macedonia and
summary: A new point 5 is added to Article 13(1): on-the-job training of workers by a foreign legal entity under an appropriate act.

text_en: 6) where, on the basis of an appropriate act for the delivery of short-term services provided by foreigners, for which the legal entity in the Republic of North Macedonia has previously expressed a labour need to the Employment Agency and has received a written reply no older than six months that the required labour cannot be secured from the domestic labour market.".
summary: A new point 6 covers short-term services by foreigners where the Employment Agency confirmed in writing, within six months, that domestic labour is unavailable.
note: Permit exemption is conditional on domestic labour being unavailable: a domestic preference, not a stated nationality condition, hence RI-FMW-001 second. Confli

text_en: Article 16 is amended to read: "(1) Registration of the work performed by foreigners is a mandatory condition that applies to all foreigners who, under the provisions of this or another law, are employed or work in the Republic of North Macedonia.
summary: Article 16 is replaced; registration of work performed by foreigners becomes mandatory for all foreigners employed or working in the country.

text_en: (2) The persons responsible under this law for registering the work performed by foreigners must register the start and the end of the work performed by foreigners, in accordance with the provisions of this law.
summary: Persons responsible for registration must register both the start and the end of work performed by foreigners.

text_en: (3) The person responsible for reporting the start of a foreigner's work may report it, in addition to the Employment Agency, at the competent regional office of the Employment Agency that previously issued the work permit or opinion and in whose area the work will be performed.
summary: The start of a foreigner's work may be reported at the Employment Agency or at the competent regional office that issued the permit or opinion.

text_en: (4) The procedure for reporting the work of a foreigner with whom an employment relationship is established may be carried out electronically if the employer holds a digital certificate.
summary: Employers holding a digital certificate may report the work of a foreign employee electronically.
note: RI-TEC-003 test: online reporting for employers within the work registration procedure, not the national portal; assigned second. TECH-EID materiality not met:

text_en: (5) The start of work of foreigners who were issued a work permit or a positive opinion, where an employment relationship is established, is reported with the electronic form M1/M2 printed from the system of the Employment Agency and the form for registering a foreigner's work.
summary: The start of a foreigner's employment is reported with the electronic M1/M2 form printed from the Employment Agency's system plus a registration form.

text_en: (6) The persons referred to in paragraph (2) of this article must report: 1) within one day of the start of work, where an employment relationship is established; 2) one day before work begins, where no employment relationship with the foreigner is established; 3) within three days of the foreigner's arrival in the country, in the cases in Article 15 paragraph (2) of this law.
summary: Responsible persons must report a foreigner's work within one day of starting, one day before starting, or within three days of arrival, by case.

text_en: (7) If the responsible person referred to in paragraph (2) does not report the start of the foreigner's work within 90 days of the issuing of the work permit or of the positive opinion on meeting the conditions for a temporary residence permit for work, it is considered that no employment relationship or work contract has been established with the foreigner, and the Employment Agency notifies the Ministry of Internal
summary: If work start is unreported within 90 days of the permit or opinion, no employment is deemed established; the Agency notifies the Interior Ministry.

text_en: (8) The Employment Agency issues the person responsible for registering the work of foreigners with a form in the prescribed format.
summary: The Employment Agency issues the responsible person with a registration form in the prescribed format.

text_en: (9) The person responsible for registration must keep the form for the entire period of the work at the main place of business and, for field work, at the construction site where the foreigner works. Where registration of the work is based on a work permit, the responsible person keeps the form for the same period for which it must keep the other prescribed documents.
summary: The responsible person must keep the registration form at the place of business or worksite throughout the work, and as long as other prescribed documents.

text_en: (10) The person responsible for registering the work performed by foreigners must present the registration form for inspection at the request of a supervisory body. If the person does not do so, it is considered not to hold such a form.
summary: The registration form must be shown to a supervisory body on request; failure to do so counts as not holding the form.

text_en: (11) If the work registration form is lost, the Employment Agency will issue a duplicate to the person responsible for registration.
summary: The Employment Agency issues a duplicate if the work registration form is lost.

text_en: (12) The person responsible for registering the work of a foreigner must register the end of the work within 30 days of the ground for termination arising and report the termination of the foreigner's work to the same office of the Employment Agency at which the registration was made.
summary: The end of a foreigner's work must be registered within 30 days and reported to the same Employment Agency office where it was registered.

text_en: (13) The responsible person deregisters the foreigner's work on the same form on which the foreigner's work was registered.
summary: Deregistration of a foreigner's work is made on the same form used for registration.

text_en: (14) The responsible person must deregister the foreigner's work no later than three days after the foreigner's work ends.
summary: The responsible person must deregister a foreigner's work within three days after it ends.

text_en: (15) The Employment Agency issues the responsible person referred to in paragraph (14) with a confirmation of deregistration of the foreigner's work.
summary: The Employment Agency issues a confirmation of deregistration of a foreigner's work.

text_en: (16) The minister responsible for labour prescribes the manner of registering and ending the work performed by foreigners, the evidence attached to the application, and the exchange of data from separate registrations between separate bodies and services.".
summary: The labour minister is to prescribe registration and deregistration procedures, supporting evidence, and data exchange between bodies.

text_en: Procedures for issuing work permits started before the date of entry into force of this law under the provisions of the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners (Official Gazette of the Republic of Macedonia No. 217/15) will be completed in accordance with this law.
summary: Work permit procedures started before entry into force are to be completed under the amending law.

text_en: Documents for registering the start of work and work permits issued before the date of entry into force of this law will remain valid until their period of validity expires.
summary: Work registration documents and work permits issued before entry into force stay valid until they expire.

text_en: The secondary legislation provided for by this law will be adopted within 30 days of the date of entry into force of this law.
summary: Secondary legislation provided for by the amending law is to be adopted within 30 days of its entry into force.

text_en: Throughout the text of the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners, the words "Republic of Macedonia" are replaced by the words "Republic of North Macedonia".
summary: The country name is updated to Republic of North Macedonia throughout the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners.
note: Formal provision of the amending law; no substantive content.

text_en: This law enters into force on the day of its publication in the "Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia".
summary: The amending law enters into force on the day of its publication in the Official Gazette.
note: Formal provision of the amending law; no substantive content.

text_en: issuing personal work permits for foreigners and giving an opinion on use of the quota and the current needs of the labour market in the Republic of North Macedonia
summary: Issuing personal work permits to foreigners and opinions on quota use and labour-market needs are among the agency's main activities.

text_en: Under the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners (Official Gazette of RM no. 217/15), the ESA is competent to issue a work permit to a foreigner whose stay in the country is regulated on another basis, on an application submitted at the Agency or in other premises it designates, to give an opinion based on use of the quota and the current labour-market needs of the Republic of North Macedonia in the procedure for r
summary: Under the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners, the agency issues work permits, gives quota and labour-market opinions, and issues work registration confirmations.

text_en: In 2021 a total of 4890 applications were submitted to the ESA, of which 792 applications for the issue of work permits and 4097 requests from the Ministry of Internal Affairs for an opinion on whether the conditions were met for issuing a temporary residence permit to a foreigner for work.
summary: In 2021 the agency received 4890 foreigner applications: 792 for work permits and 4097 Interior Ministry requests for opinions on temporary residence for work.
note: Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named.

text_en: Of these, 755 decisions issuing a work permit were adopted, 15 applications for a work permit were rejected, 21 applications for a work permit remain unresolved and 1 application for a work permit was withdrawn.
summary: Of the work permit applications, 755 were granted, 15 rejected, 21 unresolved and 1 withdrawn.
note: Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named.

text_en: In addition, 3242 opinions were given for the employment of foreigners in RNM, 206 opinions for the work of foreigners posted to RNM, 427 negative opinions to the MoI, and 204 requests remain unresolved with no opinion to the MoI.
summary: The agency gave 3242 opinions on employing foreigners, 206 on posted foreigners and 427 negative opinions; 204 requests stayed unresolved.
note: Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named.

text_en: issuing personal work permits for foreigners and giving an opinion on use of the quota and the current needs of the labour market in the Republic of North Macedonia
summary: Issuing personal work permits to foreigners and opinions on quota use and labour-market needs are among the agency's main activities.

text_en: The Law Amending the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners, which the Assembly of the Republic of North Macedonia adopted at its session held on 22 April 2025, is hereby promulgated.
summary: The President and the Speaker promulgate the amending law on employment and work of foreigners, adopted by the Assembly on 22 April 2025.
note: Formal provision of an amending law that only renames bodies.

text_en: In the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners (Official Gazette of the Republic of Macedonia No. 217/15 and Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia No. 163/21), in Article 4 paragraph (1), the words "the Ministry of Foreign Affairs" are replaced by "the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade", and the words "the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy" are replaced by "the Ministry of Economy and La
summary: Article 4(1) now names the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and the Ministry of Economy and Labour.
note: Renames bodies only; no substantive change.

text_en: In Article 5 paragraph (1), the words "the minister responsible for labour" are replaced by "the Minister of Economy and Labour". In paragraph (10), the words "the ministry responsible for labour" are replaced by "the Ministry of Economy and Labour".
summary: In the work permit quota provisions, the labour minister and ministry become the Minister and Ministry of Economy and Labour.
note: Renames bodies only; no substantive change.

text_en: In Article 7 paragraph (8), the words "the minister responsible for labour" are replaced by "the Minister of Economy and Labour".
summary: The Minister of Economy and Labour replaces the labour minister in Article 7(8) on work permit issuing rules.
note: Renames bodies only; no substantive change.

text_en: In Article 8 paragraph (2), the words "the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy" are replaced by "the Ministry of Economy and Labour".
summary: Work permit appeals under Article 8(2) now go to the Ministry of Economy and Labour.
note: Renames bodies only; no substantive change.

text_en: In Article 11 paragraph (1), the words "the Ministry of Culture" are replaced by "the Ministry of Culture and Tourism", the words "the Ministry of Economy" by "the Ministry of Economy and Labour", and the words "Agency for Youth and Sport" by "Ministry of Sport".
summary: Consent bodies for foreigners' creative services become the culture and tourism, economy and labour, and sport ministries.
note: Renames bodies only; no substantive change.

text_en: In Article 16 paragraph (16), the words "the minister responsible for labour" are replaced by "the Minister of Economy and Labour".
summary: The Minister of Economy and Labour replaces the labour minister in Article 16(16) on registering foreigners' work.
note: Renames bodies only; no substantive change.

text_en: In Article 17 and in Article 18 paragraph (1), the words "the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy" are replaced by "the Ministry of Economy and Labour".
summary: Monthly reports on foreigners' work and supervision of the law pass to the Ministry of Economy and Labour.
note: Renames bodies only; no substantive change.

text_en: In Article 21 paragraph (3), the words "the Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of Macedonia" are replaced by "the Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of North Macedonia". In paragraphs (6) and (7), the word "the Agency" is replaced by "the Employment Agency".
summary: Article 21 now names the Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of North Macedonia and the Employment Agency in its records and data provisions.
note: Renames bodies only; no substantive change.

text_en: This law enters into force on the eighth day from the date of its publication in the "Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia".
summary: The amending law enters into force on the eighth day after publication in the Official Gazette.
note: Formal provision of an amending law that only renames bodies.

text_en: Work permits for foreign workers in the region more than doubled between 2018 and 2024, from approximately 46,000 to over 100,000, driven by the departure of the domestic workforce.
summary: Work permits for foreign workers in the region more than doubled from about 46,000 in 2018 to over 100,000 in 2024.
note: Regional passage. Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named. No figure for North Macedonia.

text_en: Quota-based approaches are present in Albania, BiH, Kosovo*, Montenegro and North Macedonia.
summary: North Macedonia is among the Western Balkan partners that use quotas to regulate labour migration.
note: Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named.

text_en: Quota systems across the Western Balkans are largely set through administrative processes rather than empirical analysis, since fragmented data and the absence of systematic employer shortage-reporting leave assessments resting on general estimates and institutional perceptions.
summary: Quotas are set administratively, not empirically, because data are fragmented and employers do not systematically report shortages.
note: Regional passage. Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named.

text_en: The result is a mismatch: quota underutilisation coexists with significant unofficial labour demand in the same or adjacent sectors.
summary: Quotas go underused while significant unofficial labour demand exists in the same or adjacent sectors.
note: Regional passage. Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named.

text_en: On top of individual admission requirements, quotas add complexity and delay, pushing employers and workers toward informal or irregular channels to meet actual demand.
summary: Quotas add complexity and delay to admission, pushing employers and workers toward informal or irregular channels.
note: Regional passage. Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named.

text_en: Stakeholders highlighted the potential shift from quota-based systems to more flexible approaches, such as the use of shortage occupation lists.
summary: Stakeholders highlighted a possible shift from quotas to more flexible approaches such as shortage occupation lists.
note: Regional passage. Source concerns foreign workers generally; EU workers are not named.

text_en: In North Macedonia, two laws governing foreign employment contain overlapping mandates stakeholders describe as incoherent.
summary: Stakeholders describe overlapping mandates in North Macedonia's two laws on foreign employment as incoherent.
note: Stated as stakeholder view; the source does not name the two laws.
